definitions.gloss: great Buddha; large statue of Buddha
definitions.explanation: A very large statue of a Buddha. The best known in Japan are the bronze Great Buddhas of Tōdai-ji in Nara and Kōtoku-in in Kamakura.

examples.english: I saw the Great Buddha of Nara.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大仏|だいぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{屋外|おくがい}→屋外：04136_okugai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The Great Buddha of Kamakura stands outdoors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}→修学旅行：05590_shuugakuryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大仏|だいぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: On the school trip, many students were amazed at the size of the Great Buddha.

notes:
Usually named by place: ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大仏|だいぶつ} (at ⟦{東大寺|とうだいじ}→東大寺：31049_toudaiji⟧, eighth century, indoors in a huge wooden hall) and ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大仏|だいぶつ} (thirteenth century, outdoors since its hall was washed away). Both are standard school-trip destinations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大仏|だいぶつ}{殿|でん}: the hall that houses a great Buddha
- {大仏|だいぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拝|おが}む→拝む：00328_ogamu⟧: to pray before the Great Buddha
- {大仏|だいぶつ}⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧: the Great Buddha (familiar, respectful)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧: Buddhist statue — any statue of a Buddha or bodhisattva, of any size
